title: The final service at the Last Light restaurant
premise: Three shifts run before the observable universe closes: a quiet orbit proves the happy path, a photon rush stresses bounded concurrency, and a timeline collision makes overload and cancellation visible.

acts.summary: The build selects a product and entry, binds process capabilities, and opens the restaurant without executing imported entry modules.
acceptance: imports have no startup side effects

acts.summary: Named guests arrive with orders from three timelines; enums, refinements, patterns, literals, and units keep every value explicit.
acceptance: invalid refinements fail before service work

acts.summary: The kitchen reserves stock, samples aroma, plans energy, mixes in a parallel domain, and closes every lease on success or failure.

acts.summary: Structured tasks, bounded pipelines, streams, and directional channels process the photon rush without hiding ordering, backpressure, or cancellation.
The deterministic simulation renders a final manifest and event log, then proves replay and overload outcomes before shutdown drains the service graph.
